definition_zh: 从整体上；全面地；整体地
definition_en: in a way that treats something as a complete whole rather than as separate parts
core_image: 一只眼睛先看整幅画，再把注意力移到画面各处
scene: 面试官没有只问分数，而是把候选人的经历、性格和家庭情况放在一起权衡。The panel assessed the candidates holistically rather than ranking them by test scores alone.
sceneCN: 这里 holistically 是「从整体上」（第 1 个义项：以整体为单位来考虑或处理，而不是拆成互不相干的几块）；句意：评审组从整体上评估候选人，而不是只看考试分数排名。

pos.zh: 从整体上；全面地；整体地

collocations.zh: 整体施治；从整体上治疗病人

derivatives.zh: holistically 去掉副词后缀 -ally 得到形容词，义为「整体的、全面的」
整体论；holistic 的名词基础，由希腊语 holos（整个）加 -ism 构成
整体论者，holism 后加 -ist

senses.title: By looking at the whole
senses.definition: in a way that considers something as a complete whole rather than as separate parts
senses.definitionCN: 以把事物视为一个完整的整体、而非彼此分离的部分的方式来考虑
senses.example: A good manager looks holistically at how a team works.
senses.exampleCN: 好的管理者会从整体上考察一个团队如何运作。
senses.why: The adverb simply tells how an action is done, so holistic plus -ally becomes the everyday way of saying whole first.
senses.whyCN: 副词只是交代动作怎样进行，于是 holistic 加 -ally 就成了「先看整体」这个问题最日常的说法；句中的看法或表述是按整体来进行的。

senses.title: Considering all aspects together
senses.definition: in a way that includes every relevant aspect of a subject at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 同时把与主题相关的各个方面都包含进来的方式
senses.example: The report examines the village holistically, from water to wages.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告综合考察这个村庄，从用水一直讲到工资。
senses.why: If the whole is the target, no single aspect may be left out, so the adverb often means covering everything at once.
senses.whyCN: 既然目标是整体，任何一面都不该漏掉，所以这个副词常常带有「一次性把各方面都照看到」的意思，相当于「面面俱到」。

senses.title: Treating a person as a whole
senses.titleCN: （医疗照护）整体地；身心兼顾地
senses.definition: in a way that cares for a person as a whole, attending to body, mind and social needs together
senses.definitionCN: 把一个人当作整体来照料，身心与社会需要一并顾及的方式
senses.example: The service supports teenagers holistically, from diet to anxiety.
senses.exampleCN: 这项服务从饮食到焦虑各方面整体地支持青少年。
senses.why: Medicine calls this kind of care holistic, so its adverb describes the way a whole person is attended to in care work.
senses.whyCN: 这类照护被医学称为整体照护，因此其副词形式专门描述在照护中怎样把整个人的需求一并顾及。

senses.title: Designing for whole systems
senses.definition: in a way that plans for the behaviour of a whole system rather than one component in isolation
senses.definitionCN: 以针对整个系统的运行、而不是孤立某个部件来进行规划的方式
senses.example: The city plans its water supply holistically before any new road is built.
senses.exampleCN: 在修任何新路之前，城市会先把供水系统整体规划好。
senses.why: Planners take systems as the unit of action, and the adverb signals that a change is judged by its effect on the whole network.
senses.whyCN: 规划者把系统当作行动单位，这个副词表明一项改动要按它对整个网络的影响来评判，而不仅仅看一处是否变好。

senses.title: In a philosophical holist manner
senses.definition: in a manner associated with the philosophical view that wholes are more than their parts
senses.definitionCN: 以与「整体大于部分之和」这一哲学观点相联系的方式
senses.example: Some biologists argue holistically that ecosystems cannot be reduced to species counts.
senses.exampleCN: 一些生物学家从整体论立场主张，生态系统不能化为物种数量。
senses.why: The theory behind the word supplies one more sense, in which the adverb labels an argument, not just a method.
senses.whyCN: 这个词背后的理论再提供一层含义：此时副词标记的是一种论证立场，而不只是做事方法。

intro.en: Holistically is holistic plus the adverb ending -ally, and either adjective form appeared only after holism was coined in the nineteen twenties.
intro.cn: holistically 由 holistic 加副词词尾 -ally 构成；它的形容词形式在二十世纪二十年代 holism 造出之后才出现。

items.en: Holos means whole, entire and complete.
items.cn: 希腊语 holos 意为整个的、全部的、完整的。

items.en: Jan Smuts coins holism in his book Holism and Evolution.
items.cn: 一九二六年，扬·史末资在《整体论与进化》中造出 holism。

items.en: Holistic arises as the adjective, and holistically follows as its adverb.
items.cn: holistic 作为形容词先出现，holistically 随后作为它的副词形式出现。

items.en: Education, medicine and management adopt the adverb in policy writing.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期，教育、医疗与管理文件纷纷采用这个副词。

items.en: In modern English it usually follows verbs such as view, assess or plan.
items.cn: 现代英语中它通常跟在 view、assess、plan 这类动词后面。

note.en: Holistically is the adverb of holism and holistic, shading towards the near-meaning words comprehensively and integratively.
note.cn: holistically 是 holism 与 holistic 的副词形式，与 comprehensively、integratively 语义相通。

entries.definition: treating something as a whole
entries.definitionCN: holistically 的形容词形式，义为「整体的」

entries.definition: the theory that the whole is more than its parts
entries.definitionCN: 整体论；这个词族的理论基础

entries.definition: completely, entirely

entries.definition: sacred
entries.definitionCN: 神圣的；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: in a way that covers all or nearly all
entries.definitionCN: 全面地；广泛地，强调范围齐全

entries.definition: by combining parts into one
entries.definitionCN: 以整合方式；把各部分合为一体地

entries.definition: according to an orderly method
entries.definitionCN: 系统地；有条理地，强调方法有序

entries.definition: in an oversimplified way
entries.definitionCN: 以还原论的方式，与整体取向相对

normalIntro.en: Holistically is the adverb of the whole: it tells you how an action is done, not what the object is.
normalIntro.cn: holistically 是「整体」的副词：它说明动作是怎样做的，而不是对象是什么。

normal.en: Holistic plus -ally gives the adverb.
normal.cn: holistic 加 -ally 就得到这个副词。

normal.en: Holistically usually follows verbs such as view, assess and plan.
normal.cn: holistically 通常跟在 view、assess、plan 等动词之后。

normal.en: The -ally ending mirrors words like specifically and practically.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ally 与 specifically、practically 这类副词的构词一致。

normal.en: A holistic approach is carried out holistically, since a method and its adverb belong together.
normal.cn: holistic approach 就是 holistically 地执行，方法与副词天然成对。

normal.en: Compare wholly and holy: same opening letters, different origins.
normal.cn: 比较 wholly 与 holy：开头字母相同，来源却不同。

abstract.en: Picture an eye sweeping across a whole painting before settling on one stroke.
abstract.cn: 想象眼睛先扫过整幅画，最后才落在一笔上。

abstract.en: See a manager putting the budget, the staff and the customers on one large sheet.
abstract.cn: 想象管理者把预算、员工和客户写在同一张大纸上。

abstract.en: Think of turning a jigsaw box upright so the finished picture appears at once.
abstract.cn: 想象把拼图盒子立起来，完成后的整幅画面一次显现。

examples.en: The committee reviewed the proposal holistically, weighing costs, safety and community support.
examples.cn: 委员会综合审阅了提案，把成本、安全和社区支持一并权衡。

examples.en: Nurses are trained to treat older patients holistically.
examples.cn: 护士受过训练，要从整体上照顾年长的病人。

examples.en: Students who think holistically often connect ideas from very different subjects.
examples.cn: 整体思考的学生常常能把不同学科的想法联系起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「合力思力」——把各方的合力与思路拧成一股，整体地思考；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 holos（整个、完整）→ holism（整体论，二十世纪造词）→ holistic（整体的）→ holistically（以整体方式，加副词词尾 -ally）。

sensesIntro.en: Holistically starts as the plain adverb of looking at the whole, widens to covering all aspects, and then serves medicine, planning and philosophy.
sensesIntro.cn: holistically 首先是最普通的「看整体」副词，扩展为「涵盖各方面」，再服务于医疗、规划与哲学领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an eye that sees the whole picture before the strokes.
core.cn: 核心意象：眼睛先看到整幅画面，再看笔触。

branches.en: The plain adverb of seeing the whole is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 最基本的义项是「看整体」的普通副词用法。

branches.en: Including every aspect is the comprehensive sense.
branches.cn: 把各方面都纳入进来，是综合义项。

branches.en: Care for the whole person is the medical adverb.
branches.cn: 照护整个人，是医疗中的副词用法。

branches.en: Planning whole systems is the technical application.
branches.cn: 对系统作整体规划，是技术性用法。

branches.en: The holist argument gives the philosophical sense.
branches.cn: 整体论的论证立场给出哲学义项。

intro.en: Holistically combines a Greek root with two English suffixes, so it can be taken apart as hol, istic and ally.
intro.cn: holistically 由希腊词根加两个英语后缀构成，可以拆成 hol、istic 与 ally 三段来记。

latinIntro.en: The family descends from Greek rather than Latin; the comparison entries below are Greek forms kept for reference.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词族源自希腊语而非拉丁语；下面列出的是供对照参考的希腊语形式。

items.example: Holos supplies the whole image.
items.exampleCN: holos 提供「整个」的核心意象。

items.example: The suffix -ism forms holism.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ism 构成 holism。

items.meaning: the theory that the whole is primary
items.example: Holism is the noun behind the adverb.
items.exampleCN: holism 是这个副词背后的名词基础。

items.meaning: relating to a theory or manner
items.meaningCN: 表示「与某理论或方式有关的」
items.example: The suffix -istic forms holistic.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -istic 构成 holistic。

items.example: A holistic reading comes before the details.
items.exampleCN: 先有整体性阅读，再看细节。

items.meaningCN: 表示「以……方式」的副词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ally forms holistically.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ally 构成 holistically。

items.example: Judges scored the dance holistically.
items.exampleCN: 评委从整体上为舞蹈打分。

items.example: A holistic approach is often described holistically.
items.exampleCN: 整体方法常被描述为从整体出发。

items.meaningCN: 原子论的；与整体取向相对
items.example: Atomistic and holistic readings differ in starting points.
items.exampleCN: 原子论与整体论的读法起点不同。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 整个的，供对照的希腊语词根

latinEntries.meaningCN: 把事物视为一个整体，是 holism 的词根来源

definition_zh: 顺势疗法；同类疗法；以其法治其病
definition_en: a system of alternative medicine in which very small doses of a remedy are given to treat an illness with symptoms similar to the illness
core_image: 病人喝下的药水极淡，淡到多半只是水，却号称能唤起身体自己的抗病力
scene: 诊室里，医生放下听诊器，建议湿疹反复发作的旅客试试一种温和的另类疗法。The doctor put down the stethoscope and suggested that the visitor with recurring eczema try homeopathy.
sceneCN: 这里 homeopathy 是「顺势疗法」（第 2 个义项：德国医生哈内曼创立的另类医疗体系）；句意：医生放下听诊器，建议湿疹反复发作的旅客试试顺势疗法。

pos.zh: 顺势疗法；同类疗法；以其法治其病
顺势疗法的（只作定语，如 homeopathy clinic 顺势疗法诊所，日常更常用 homeopathic）

collocations.zh: 英国国民保健体系中的顺势疗法服务

derivatives.zh: 顺势疗法的；由 -ic 构成的形容词
顺势疗法医师（美式拼作 homoeopath）
同义异拼，保留希腊 oe 的英式正式拼写
对抗疗法；与顺势疗法相对的做法
自然疗法；共享 -pathy 后缀的另类疗法

senses.title: The same treatment for the same illness
senses.definition: the oldest and literal sense of the word in classical Greek, a style of treatment that uses what is like the disease
senses.definitionCN: 该词在古典希腊语中最古老、最字面的含义：用与疾病相类的东西来治疗
senses.example: In classical Greek medicine the word already pointed to treating like with like.
senses.exampleCN: 在古典希腊医学中，这个词已经指向「以其法治其病」。
senses.why: Homoios means like and pathos means suffering, so the compound first names a matching cure, long before Samuel Hahnemann turned the phrase into a full system.
senses.whyCN: homoios 意为「相似」，pathos 意为「病痛」，所以这个词先指一种「以同类治同类」的疗法，远比哈内曼把它发展成完整体系要早。

senses.title: The alternative medical system
senses.definition: the alternative medical system set up by Samuel Hahnemann, where remedies are hugely diluted and chosen by similarity of symptoms
senses.definitionCN: 德国医生哈内曼创立的另类医疗体系，药剂经过大幅稀释，并按症状的相似性来选择用药
senses.example: Homeopathy was one of the earliest well organized forms of alternative medicine in Europe.
senses.exampleCN: 顺势疗法是欧洲最早形成体系的另类疗法之一。
senses.why: This is the dominant modern sense, where a Greek principle of likeness grew into a whole clinical doctrine with dilution and potentisation.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最主要的义项：希腊语的「相似」原则发展为配合稀释与振荡的完整临床学说。

senses.title: A very small dose of a remedy
senses.definition: used loosely for a very dilute remedy, or by opponents for a cure that is thought to contain little or nothing
senses.definitionCN: 口语中泛指极稀的药剂，批评者则用来揶揄那种几乎没有有效成分的治疗
senses.example: Critics joked that water for a cold is just homeopathy in a bottle.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者打趣说，治感冒的白水不过是瓶装的顺势疗法。
senses.why: Because the doses are diluted again and again, the name came to stand for the tiny dose itself, and from there for a claim seen as faint.
senses.whyCN: 因为药剂被反复稀释，这个词便逐渐代表那种极微的剂量，进而衍生出「淡而无实数」的引申用法。

senses.title: Used before a noun to describe practitioners
senses.titleCN: 作定语：顺势疗法的（从业者）
senses.definition: placing the word before another noun to describe people or places linked with this kind of medicine
senses.definitionCN: 把这个词放在另一个名词前，描述与这种医疗相关的从医者或场所
senses.example: A homeopathy pharmacy can be found at the end of the street in some old European towns.
senses.exampleCN: 在一些欧洲老城的街尾，能找到一家顺势疗法药房。
senses.why: Many medicine terms double as modifiers, so homeopathy shifts adjectivally to label practitioners and shops.
senses.whyCN: 许多医学术语都能直接充当定语，于是 homeopathy 便顺势用来修饰从业者与药房。

intro.en: Homeopathy is a Greek compound of homoios, meaning like, and pathos, meaning suffering, formed in the early 1800s by Samuel Hahnemann to label his system.
intro.cn: homeopathy 是希腊语复合词，由 homoios（相似）与 pathos（苦难、病痛）构成，十九世纪初由德国医生哈内曼定型命名。

items.en: Homoios means like or similar, and pathos means suffering or disease.
items.cn: homoios 意为「相像的」，pathos 意为「苦难、疾病」。

items.en: Greek physicians already used the idea of like curing like.
items.cn: 希腊医者早已使用「以类治类」的观念。

items.en: Hahnemann published his Organon and gave the Latin-based name Homoeopathie to the new approach.
items.cn: 一八一〇年前后，哈内曼发表《医师法则》，用同源的德语称谓 Homoeopathie 命名新疗法。

items.en: Homeopathy enters English in the early 1800s with the handbook spelling oe.
items.cn: 十九世纪初 homeopathy 进入英语，早期拼写为带 oe 的 homeopathy。

items.en: Homeopathy competes with homeopathic, homeopath and allopathy into contemporary usage.
items.cn: 现代英语中，它与 homeopathic、homeopath、allopathy 等派生词并存使用。

note.en: Homeopathy joins the Greek roots homoios and pathos, so its look-alikes share a root with suffering or likeness, while near meanings belong to medicine and cure.
note.cn: homeopathy 由希腊语 homoios 与 pathos 构成，因此形近词多含「病痛」或「相似」的词根，近义词则来自医疗与治愈这一语义场。

entries.definition: a doctor who practises homeopathy
entries.definitionCN: 顺势疗法医师，与 homeopathy 同根

entries.definition: relating to or produced by homeopathy
entries.definitionCN: 与顺势疗法有关的，由 -ic 派生而成

entries.definition: a feeling of sorrow, from the Greek word for suffering
entries.definitionCN: 悲痛、哀伤，直接来自希腊语中表示「苦难」的词，与词尾 -pathy 同根

entries.definition: treatments used instead of conventional medicine
entries.definitionCN: 替代医学；不使用常规医学方法的疗法总称

entries.definition: a system of treatment through diet and natural means
entries.definitionCN: 自然疗法；以饮食与自然手段治病，共享 -pathy 词尾

entries.definition: treatment by inserting needles into the skin
entries.definitionCN: 针灸；同为较常见的另类疗法

normalIntro.en: Homeopathy tells its own story: homo is same and pathos is illness, so the cure is supposed to match the illness.
normalIntro.cn: homeopathy 把道理写在词里：homo 是「相同」，pathos 是「病痛」，所以解药要与病情相配。

normal.en: Homo in Greek means the same, as in homogeneous.
normal.cn: 希腊语 homo 意为「相同」，homogeneous（同质的）里也有它。

normal.en: The ending pathy means disease or suffering, as in sympathy with someone sick.
normal.cn: 词尾 pathy 表示「疾病、受苦」，sympathy（同情）里也藏着它。

normal.en: So homeopathy means treating a disease with something like the disease.
normal.cn: 所以 homeopathy 就是「用像病的东西来治病」。

normal.en: The opposite approach has its own label, allopathy, from allos, meaning other.
normal.cn: 对立面的做法另有名称 allopathy，来自 allos（他者），即用相反之物对抗。

normal.en: Learn the family together: homeopath, homeopathic and the British spelling homoeopathy.
normal.cn: 把词族一起记：homeopath、homeopathic，以及英式异拼 homoeopathy。

abstract.en: Picture two matching keys, one named like and one named illness, opening the same door.
abstract.cn: 想象两把配对的钥匙，一把叫「相似」，一把叫「病」，一起打开同一扇门。

abstract.en: See a bottle of medicine diluted again and again until only water is left.
abstract.cn: 想象一瓶药水被一次次稀释，最后只剩下水。

abstract.en: Hear the teasing slogan that a cold cured by plain water is only a drop of homeopathy.
abstract.cn: 想象那句打趣的话：靠白水治感冒，不过是「一点顺势疗法」。

examples.en: Some patients turn to homeopathy when conventional drugs cause side effects.
examples.cn: 一些病人因常规药物有副作用而转向顺势疗法。

examples.en: Reviews of homeopathy have found little evidence that the diluted remedies work.
examples.cn: 关于顺势疗法的综述几乎找不到证据表明这种稀释药剂有效。

examples.en: Homeopathic remedies are sold in small glass bottles.
examples.cn: 顺势疗法药剂装在小小的玻璃瓶里出售。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吼，米熬怕西」——吼一声、拿米熬成稀汤，稀到不能再稀，就是顺势疗法那瓶极淡的药水；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 homoios（相似的）+ pathos（苦难、病痛）→ 德语 Homoeopathie（哈内曼，约一八一〇年命名）→ 英语 homeopathy，核心义「以相似之物治相似之病」。

sensesIntro.en: Homeopathy starts as the Greek rule of curing like with like, becomes the full alternative system of Hahnemann, widens to the tiny diluted dose, and ends as a modifier before nouns.
sensesIntro.cn: homeopathy 最早是希腊语「以类治类」的法则，后来成为哈内曼的完整另类医疗体系，又泛指极稀的药剂，最后退而充当名词前的定语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a glass of very dilute medicine meant to awaken the same illness it resembles.
core.cn: 核心意象：一杯极稀的药，号称能唤起与病情相似的力量。

branches.en: The literal Greek rule of treating like with like.
branches.cn: 希腊语字面义：以同类之法治同类之病。

branches.en: The organized alternative system belongs to the modern sense.
branches.cn: 成体系的另类医疗属于现代的主要义项。

branches.en: The endlessly diluted dose is the everyday extension.
branches.cn: 反复稀释后的极微剂量是日常引申义。

branches.en: Put before another noun, the word simply labels people and places.
branches.cn: 置于名词前时，它只用来标示相关的人与场所。

branches.en: Both the system and its dose share the same tiny-nothing reputation.
branches.cn: 体系与剂量共享「几近于无」的名声。

intro.en: Homeopathy is built from two Greek-friendly pieces, homo- for like and -pathy for suffering, with homeopath, homeopathic, homeopathy and allopathy around it.
intro.cn: homeopathy 由两个希腊成分拼成：homo- 表示「相似」，-pathy 表示「病痛」，周围则形成 homeopath、homeopathic、homoeopathy、allopathy 等词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin and Greek heritage carries homoios and pathos, and the medical Latin pathia supplies the -pathy suffix.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊与拉丁传统中留下 homoios 与 pathos 两个词根，医学拉丁语的 pathia 提供了 -pathy 词尾。

items.example: Homo- signals sameness in homeopathy.
items.exampleCN: homo- 在 homeopathy 中传递「相同」之意。

items.example: The suffix -pathy names an illness or a way of treating it.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -pathy 指疾病或治疗疾病的方法。

items.meaning: the system of treating like with like
items.meaningCN: 顺势疗法；以其法治其病
items.example: Homeopathy joins the two roots into one medical name.
items.exampleCN: homeopathy 把两个词根合为一个医学名称。

items.example: Homeopath replaces the ending with a word for a person.
items.exampleCN: homeopath 把词尾换成表示「人」的形式。

items.example: The suffix -ic forms the adjective homeopathic.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 构成形容词 homeopathic。

items.example: All- contrasts with homo- in allopathy.
items.exampleCN: 在 allopathy 中，all- 与 homo- 相对。

items.example: Allopathy was coined to contrast with homeopathy.
items.exampleCN: allopathy 是为与 homeopathy 对照而造的。

items.example: Hahnemann called himself a physician, but an -ist would name a practitioner.
items.exampleCN: 哈内曼自称医师，而 -ist 词尾可用来指从业者。

items.meaning: the older oe spelling of homo-
items.meaningCN: homo- 的旧式 oe 拼写
items.example: British dictionaries keep homoeopathy beside homeopathy.
items.exampleCN: 英式词典把 homoeopathy 与 homeopathy 并列收录。

latinEntries.example: Homoios is the first element of homeopathy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: homoios 是 homeopathy 的第一部分。

latinEntries.example: Latinate pathia links homeopathy with naturopathy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁化的 pathia 把 homeopathy 与 naturopathy 联系起来。

definition_zh: 想家的；思乡的；因远离家乡而惆怅的
definition_en: missing your home and the people you love when you are away from them
core_image: 异乡的窗边，一个人盯着手机里家门口的照片，心里空出一块叫家的地方
scene: 初到异国的第一周，宿舍的饭菜不合口，深夜她翻出家里的旧相册，忽然一阵难受。Alone in her dorm on the first night abroad, she opened an old family album and felt homesick.
sceneCN: 这里 homesick 是「想家的」（第 1 个义项：离开家后因思念家乡和亲人而难过）；句意：出国第一夜，她独自在宿舍翻开旧家庭相册，感到想家。

pos.zh: 想家的；思乡的；因远离家乡而惆怅的

derivatives.zh: 思乡；乡愁，由 homesick 加 -ness 构成
家；home 是核心成分，homesick 由它加 -sick 复合而成
有病的；感到难受的；另一核心成分，取「难受」之义
晕船的；同一 -sick 模式，但 sick 取「恶心」之义

senses.title: Missing home and loved ones
senses.definition: feeling sad because you are away from home and the people you love
senses.definitionCN: 因为离开家和亲爱的人而感到难过
senses.example: Many exchange students feel homesick during the first month.
senses.exampleCN: 许多交换生在头一个月会感到想家。
senses.why: Home plus sick, where sick means unwell, gives a body that aches for its own place, which is the core everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: home 加 sick（不舒服），构成「身体为故乡而难过」的画面，这正是最日常的核心义项。

senses.title: Yearning for familiar surroundings
senses.definition: longing for familiar surroundings, routines or food rather than a house itself
senses.definitionCN: 怀念的是熟悉的环境、日常与饮食，而不一定是那所房子
senses.example: Living overseas for years, he grew homesick for the smell of rain on his street.
senses.exampleCN: 旅居海外多年，他渐渐怀念自家街道上雨后的气味。
senses.why: Once the word moves onto an adult who has made a new home, the missing shifts from family to familiar detail.
senses.whyCN: 当这个词用到已经在外安家的成年人身上，思念的对象就从亲人扩展为熟悉的细节。

senses.title: A nostalgia in later life
senses.definition: a quiet sense of nostalgia for an earlier time and place that can no longer be visited
senses.definitionCN: 对已经回不去的往日与故地的淡淡思念
senses.example: In her letters from the old town, the writer sounded homesick for a childhood that no longer existed.
senses.exampleCN: 作家从老城写来的信里，透着对一个已不复存在的童年的怀念。
senses.why: Because home can mean a lost time as well as a place, the adjective stretches into literary nostalgia for the past.
senses.whyCN: 因为 home 也可以指一个已经逝去的时光，并非只是个地点，所以这个词能延伸到文学里对往昔的乡愁。

senses.title: Homesickness felt in a workplace
senses.titleCN: 在工作场所感到的失落
senses.definition: used loosely for missing a previous workplace, city or team after moving somewhere new
senses.definitionCN: 泛指换到新地方后怀念旧单位、旧城市或旧团队
senses.example: The new teachers seemed friendly, but he still felt homesick for his old staff room.
senses.exampleCN: 新同事都很友好，可他仍想念从前的教研室。
senses.why: When working abroad becomes common, the word loosens again, with home standing for the familiar place of work.
senses.whyCN: 当外派工作变得普遍，这个词再度放宽，home 便用来指熟悉的工作之地。

intro.en: Homesick is a two-part English compound, home from Old English ham and sick from Old English seoc, and the word is recorded in English from the 1700s.
intro.cn: homesick 是英语复合词，由古英语 ham（家）与 seoc（有病、难受）组合而成，英语书面记录见于十八世纪。

items.en: Ham means one place of dwelling, estate or village, and seoc means ill.
items.cn: ham 指住处、庄园或村落，seoc 意为「有病的、难受的」。

items.en: Sailors and settlers who left home let the two words come together as a fixed compound.
items.cn: 随着水手与移民离家远行，这两个词合成了固定的复合词。

items.en: Dictionaries record homesick in the 1700s, often first in accounts of soldiers and colonists.
items.cn: 词典在十八世纪收录 homesick，早期多出现在关于士兵与殖民者的记述里。

items.en: In the 1800s homesickness was described as a real disorder of soldiers and emigrants.
items.cn: 十九世纪，思乡病被当成士兵与移民中真实存在的病症记录下来。

items.en: Home and sick are among the oldest English words, and homesick keeps both without change.
items.cn: home 与 sick 都是英语中最古老的词之一，homesick 至今沿用了它们的原形。

note.en: Homesick joins two very old English words, home and sick, so its look-alikes share either half, while near meanings name the ache of being far from home.
note.cn: homesick 由英语两个非常古老的词 home 与 sick 组合而成，因此形近词各含其中一半，近义词则都表达远离家乡的那种难受。

entries.definition: the feeling of being homesick
entries.definitionCN: 思乡；乡愁，由 homesick 加 -ness 构成的同根名词

entries.definition: feeling ill because of the movement of a boat
entries.definitionCN: 晕船的；结构相同，但 sick 取「恶心」之义

entries.definition: the country where you are a citizen
entries.definitionCN: 祖国；故乡，共享 home 这个成分

entries.definition: feeling love or sadness about a happy time you remember
entries.definitionCN: 怀旧的；对往昔时光的留恋

entries.definition: a strong wish for someone or somewhere you cannot have
entries.definitionCN: 渴望；思念

entries.definition: sadly thinking about what you have lost
entries.definitionCN: 惆怅的；怅惘的

normalIntro.en: Homesick is transparently made of home and sick, so the picture is an illness of the heart caused by no longer being home.
normalIntro.cn: homesick 由 home 与 sick 透明组合，画面就是「因为不在家而心里生病」。

normal.en: Sick here does not mean physically ill, but uneasy and unhappy.
normal.cn: 这里的 sick 不是真的生病，而是难受、不舒坦。

normal.en: The verb pattern is be or feel homesick, never suffer from a homesick.
normal.cn: 常用结构是 be 或 feel homesick，也可以说 have homesick days 这样作定语。

normal.en: Add -ness to name the feeling itself, homesickness.
normal.cn: 加上 -ness 就得到表示这种感觉本身的名词 homesickness。

normal.en: Lines like I am homesick for a place I never left show how the word can reach beyond geography.
normal.cn: 「我思念一个我从未离开过的地方」这类句子，说明它可以延伸到地理之外。

normal.en: Compare seasick and lovesick, built on the same -sick pattern.
normal.cn: 对比 seasick（晕船）和 lovesick（相思），它们都用同一个 -sick 模式。

abstract.en: See a small house inside a heart, and the heart feels queasy every time it is far away.
abstract.cn: 想象心里装着一座小房子，每次离家远一点，心就难受一分。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pressing flat against a glass door while the train leaves.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手贴在玻璃门上，而列车正在开走。

abstract.en: Hear a phone video of a family meal playing alone on a small screen.
abstract.cn: 想象小小的手机屏上独自播放着家人吃饭的视频。

examples.en: Most new students feel homesick for the first two weeks.
examples.cn: 大多数新生在头两周会想家。

examples.en: After a month of spicy street food, she grew homesick for her mother soup.
examples.cn: 吃了一个月辣的街头小吃，她开始想念母亲做的汤。

examples.en: Letters from home helped the soldiers manage their homesickness.
examples.cn: 家书帮助士兵们缓解思乡之情。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「轰姆 sick」——一想到「轰」隆隆的火车把「姆」妈带走，人就 sick 一样难受，于是想家；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 ham（家；住处）+ 古英语 seoc（有病的、难受的）→ 十八世纪固定为复合词 homesick，核心义「因离家而心里难受」。

sensesIntro.en: Homesick begins with the childlike ache of missing family, widens to any familiar surroundings, then leans into adult nostalgia and even the nostalgia of a former workplace.
sensesIntro.cn: homesick 最初指孩子般想念家人的难受，随后扩展为对任何熟悉环境的怀念，再延伸到成年人的乡愁，乃至对旧工作环境的牵挂。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person at a far window, heart aching for a place called home.
core.cn: 核心意象：人在远方的窗前，心里为「家」这个所在而发疼。

branches.en: Missing family is the warm everyday core.
branches.cn: 想念家人是最温暖也最日常的核心义。

branches.en: Familiar food and streets replace the house itself.
branches.cn: 熟悉的饭菜与街道取代了房子本身。

branches.en: Adult nostalgia for a lost time grows from the same root.
branches.cn: 成年人对逝去时光的怀念由此同一核心生长而来。

branches.en: A workplace can stand in for home in the loosest use.
branches.cn: 在最宽泛的用法里，工作场所也能代替故乡。

branches.en: Family and familiar surroundings usually ache together.
branches.cn: 亲人与熟悉的环境往往同时让人难受。

intro.en: Homesick is a compound of two native English words, home and sick, so its word-building is mostly compounding and the -ness derivative, with no Latin affix at its core.
intro.cn: homesick 由英语本土词 home 与 sick 复合而成，构词主要是复合与 -ness 派生，核心并无拉丁词缀。

latinIntro.en: Both parts of homesick are Germanic, so the Latin entries below are honestly marked as source words of the English halves rather than classical Latin affixes.
latinIntro.cn: homesick 的两个成分都是日耳曼语词，下列拉丁条目只作对照说明，并非古典拉丁词缀。

items.example: Home is the first half of homesick.
items.exampleCN: home 是 homesick 的前半部分。

items.example: Sick is the second half and means uneasy here.
items.exampleCN: sick 是后半部分，这里取「难受」之意。

items.example: The two words combine to describe a state of heart.
items.exampleCN: 两个词合起来描述一种心情状态。

items.meaningCN: 构成抽象名词，表示「状态、性质」
items.example: The suffix -ness turns homesick into homesickness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ness 把 homesick 变成 homesickness。

items.example: Homesickness names the feeling itself.
items.exampleCN: homesickness 是那种感觉本身的名字。

items.example: Sea replaces home in the parallel compound seasick.
items.exampleCN: 在平行的复合词 seasick 中，sea 替换了 home。

items.example: Seasick keeps sick in its bodily sense.
items.exampleCN: seasick 里的 sick 保留了生理上的「有病」义。

items.example: Lovesick borrows the same pattern for longing.
items.exampleCN: lovesick（相思的）沿用了同一个构词模式。

items.example: The for phrase lets the word point at food or streets.
items.exampleCN: 用 for 引导时，这个词可以具体指向食物或街道。

latinEntries.example: Domus is listed for contrast with the Germanic home.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 列出 domus 只为与日耳曼词 home 对照。

latinEntries.example: Morbus is the Latin disease word behind sick ideas.
latinEntries.exampleCN: morbus 是表达「疾病」的拉丁词，与 sick 一词的想法相通。

latinEntries.example: Latin sum shows why being homesick is a state verb.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 sum 提示了「想家」为何是一种状态。

definition_zh: 寄宿家庭；寄宿（留学生住在当地家庭里）；同住当地家庭的住宿方式
definition_en: an arrangement in which a visitor or student lives with a local family, or the family that provides this
core_image: 一栋陌生的房子里，房东端上热饭，房客的行李箱刚放进客房
scene: 暑期语言课程的招生简章上，除了学费和课时，还列出一项住在当地人家里的安排。The brochure for the summer language course lists tuition, lesson hours and a homestay with a local family.
sceneCN: 这里 homestay 是「寄宿家庭安排」（第 1 个义项：留学生住在当地家庭里的住宿方式）；句意：暑期语言课程的招生简章列出了学费、课时，以及与当地家庭同住的寄宿安排。

pos.zh: 寄宿家庭；寄宿（留学生住在当地家庭里）
寄宿的（作定语，如 homestay family 寄宿家庭、homestay programme 寄宿项目）

collocations.zh: 住在寄宿家庭里（常用搭配 live with a homestay family）

derivatives.zh: 寄宿者；住寄宿家庭的游客，由 homestay 加 -er 构成
寄宿家庭；接待家庭，语义上与 homestay 相对应
供膳寄宿处；结构相近的住宿名称

senses.title: Living with a local family
senses.titleCN: 住在当地家庭里的寄宿安排
senses.definition: a study or travel arrangement in which you live for a while with a local family, often with meals included
senses.definitionCN: 留学或旅行时，一段时间内住进当地家庭的安排，通常含餐
senses.example: Her course offered either dormitory rooms or homestay with a family in the suburbs.
senses.exampleCN: 她的课程可以选择宿舍，也可以选择市郊家庭的寄宿。
senses.why: Home and stay join into a compact phrase for a stay in a home that is not yours, which is the core modern sense.
senses.whyCN: home 与 stay 合成「在别人的家里停留」这一紧凑说法，这是现代最核心的义项。

senses.title: The host family and its charge
senses.titleCN: 寄宿家庭（接待方及其家庭）
senses.definition: used for the household that receives the student or visitor
senses.definitionCN: 用来指接待学生或游客的那户人家
senses.example: The homestay has two children and a large kitchen where the students help cook.
senses.exampleCN: 这户寄宿家庭有两个孩子，还有一间大厨房，学生们在那里帮忙做饭。
senses.why: By metonymy the name of the arrangement passes to the household that operates it.
senses.whyCN: 借代之下，这种安排的名称转指经营它的那户人家。

senses.title: A budget room service for travellers
senses.titleCN: 面向游客的民宿式寄宿
senses.definition: a cheap room and sometimes breakfast offered by local residents to visitors in tourist areas
senses.definitionCN: 旅游地区当地居民向游客提供的平价房间，有时含早餐
senses.example: In the old town, many families run a small homestay for walkers on the coast path.
senses.exampleCN: 在老城，许多家庭为海岸步道上的徒步者经营小寄宿。
senses.why: The same structure that serves students in cities spreads to tourism, where the family scale is the selling point.
senses.whyCN: 为学生服务的城市寄宿结构扩散到旅游业，此时「家庭规模」成为卖点。

intro.en: Homestay is a modern English compound of home and stay, recorded from the twentieth century as a travel and study arrangement, not a word with classical roots.
intro.cn: homestay 是现代英语复合词，由 home 与 stay 拼接而成，二十世纪才作为旅行与留学的住宿方式见于记录，并无古典词根。

items.en: Ham means home, dwelling or village, and English home keeps this root.
items.cn: 古英语 ham 意为「家、住处或村落」，英语 home 沿用了这个根。

items.en: The verb stay appears from Old French estaier, meaning to stay or remain.
items.cn: 动词 stay 约在中古英语时期借自古法语 estaier，意为「停留、逗留」。

items.en: Language schools after the 1960s began placing overseas students with local families and called it homestay.
items.cn: 二十世纪六十年代以后的语言学校开始把海外学生安置在当地家庭，并把这种做法称作 homestay。

items.en: Homestay spreads as a label for family-run rooms in rural and coastal tourism.
items.cn: 寄宿式住房在乡村与沿海旅游业中流行，homestay 随之成为这类家庭客房的统称。

items.en: The compound often loses its hyphen and works both as a noun and as a modifier.
items.cn: 现代英语里它多不再加连字符，名词与定语两种用法都通行。

note.en: Homestay is a plain compound of home and stay, so its look-alikes are home-based words, while near meanings are the many names for paid lodging.
note.cn: homestay 是 home 与 stay 的朴素复合，因此形近词都以 home 为核心成分，近义词则是各种付费住宿的名称。

entries.definition: the spelling with a space between the two parts
entries.definitionCN: 中间空格的异写形式，与 homestay 同义

entries.definition: someone who stays with a local family
entries.definitionCN: 住在寄宿家庭里的寄宿者，与 homestay 同根

entries.definition: a cheap supervised place with shared rooms
entries.definitionCN: 青年旅舍，只是拼写近似，词源来自拉丁语接待处，与 homestay 无关

entries.definition: the family that takes in a student or visitor
entries.definitionCN: 接待学生或游客的寄宿家庭

entries.definition: a private house offering a room and morning meal
entries.definitionCN: 提供床铺与早餐的家庭旅馆

entries.definition: a small private hotel
entries.definitionCN: 小旅馆；客栈

normalIntro.en: Homestay reads like its own definition: a stay in a home, so just join the two ordinary words together.
normalIntro.cn: homestay 几乎写出了自己的定义：在一个 home 里 stay，只要把两个普通词连起来即可。

normal.en: Stay is both the noun and the verb, so a homestay is literally a home where you stay.
normal.cn: stay 既可作名词也可作动词，所以 homestay 字面就是「你停留的人家」。

normal.en: The plural is homestays, and the hyphenated home-stay also appears in print.
normal.cn: 复数是 homestays，印刷中也可见带连字符的 home-stay。

normal.en: Before another noun it stays open-ended, as in homestay family or homestay programme.
normal.cn: 放在名词前时可自由搭配，如 homestay family 寄宿家庭、homestay programme 寄宿项目。

normal.en: North American and Australian schools used the word early, alongside the phrase host family.
normal.cn: 北美与澳洲的语言学校较早使用这个词，并与 host family 一词并用。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with hostel, which is a shared building rather than a home.
normal.cn: 注意别和 hostel 混淆，那是共享房间的旅舍，不是「家」。

abstract.en: Picture a front door that opens into someone else kitchen on your first evening abroad.
abstract.cn: 想象出国第一晚，一扇门打开，迎面是别人家的厨房。

abstract.en: See a sign outside a country house that simply reads rooms in a family home.
abstract.cn: 想象乡间小屋外挂着招牌，写着「家庭留宿」。

abstract.en: Imagine birthday soup served to a visitor whose name the host already remembered.
abstract.cn: 想象主人端来生日汤，还记得客人的名字。

examples.en: International students usually spend two weeks in homestay before finding an apartment.
examples.cn: 国际学生通常先在寄宿家庭住两周，再找公寓。

examples.en: The homestay families in this town are checked by the school every year.
examples.cn: 镇上的寄宿家庭每年都由学校核查。

examples.en: Living in a homestay helped her learn the local accent quickly.
examples.cn: 住在寄宿家庭帮她很快学会了当地口音。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「红家的四妹」——红家收留了一位叫四妹的留学生，让她在家里住下，这就是寄宿家庭；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 现代英语复合词：home（家，古英语 ham）+ stay（停留）→ homestay「在别人家里停留」，指寄宿家庭式的住宿安排，非古典词根构词。

sensesIntro.en: Homestay starts as the study arrangement with a local family, shifts by metonymy to the family itself, and extends into tourism as a low-cost room service.
sensesIntro.cn: homestay 先指与当地家庭同住的留学安排，再借代指接待的那户人家，然后扩展到旅游业中的平价客房服务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open front door, a warm kitchen and a suitcase left in a guest room.
core.cn: 核心意象：敞开的家门、暖热的厨房，和放在客房的行李箱。

branches.en: The study arrangement is the central modern sense.
branches.cn: 留学住宿安排是核心的现代义项。

branches.en: The household itself takes the name by metonymy.
branches.cn: 那户人家借代地获得了这个名字。

branches.en: Cheap family rooms in tourist areas are the loosest branch.
branches.cn: 旅游区廉价的家庭客房是最宽的延伸。

branches.en: Both the study and the tourist use advertise family life as the attraction.
branches.cn: 留学与旅游两种用法都以「家庭生活」为吸引力。

branches.en: A student and the host family share the same word from two sides.
branches.cn: 学生与接待家庭从两侧共用同一个词。

intro.en: Homestay is formed by compounding two everyday English words, home and stay, with host family nearby in the same field and no Latin affix inside.
intro.cn: homestay 由 home 与 stay 两个日常英语词复合而成，同一语义场里的 host family 与之对应，内部没有拉丁词缀。

latinIntro.en: This compound is Germanic and partly Old French in origin, so the Latin entries below are given only for comparison with the English halves.
latinIntro.cn: 这个复合词源自日耳曼语，兼有古法语影响，下列拉丁条目只用于与英语成分对照。

items.example: Home supplies the first half of homestay.
items.exampleCN: home 提供 homestay 的前一半。

items.example: Stay supplies the second half, so the word means a home where you stay.
items.exampleCN: stay 提供后一半，全词意为「你停留的人家」。

items.example: Homestay is used freely as a modifier.
items.exampleCN: homestay 常直接充当定语。

items.example: The suffix -er forms homestayer.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 构成 homestayer。

items.meaningCN: 寄宿者；住寄宿家庭的人
items.example: Homestayer names the visitor, not the host.
items.exampleCN: homestayer 指寄宿的客人，而不是房东。

items.example: Host combines with family to name the household.
items.exampleCN: host 与 family 组合成指代那户人家的说法。

items.meaning: meals provided in return for payment
items.example: Board and lodging is the older name for the service homestay offers.
items.exampleCN: board and lodging 是 homestay 所提供的服务的老说法。

items.example: Lodging overlaps with homestay in the meaning of a place for the night.
items.exampleCN: lodging 与 homestay 在「临时住处」这一含义上重叠。

items.example: A long homestay can still leave a guest homesick.
items.exampleCN: 住得再久的寄宿，也可能仍让客人想家。

latinEntries.example: Domus contrasts with the Germanic home.
latinEntries.exampleCN: domus 与日耳曼词 home 形成对照。

latinEntries.example: Stare belongs to a separate Latin family and is not the source of stay.
latinEntries.exampleCN: stare 属于另一支拉丁词族，并不是 stay 的来源。

definition_zh: 杀人；凶杀案；杀人者
definition_en: the killing of one person by another, or a person who kills another
core_image: 一只握刀的手落下，一个人的生命被另一只手切断
scene: 深夜的巷口拉起警戒线，警察在雨中调查一起命案。Detectives opened a homicide investigation after the body was found.
sceneCN: 这里 homicide 是「凶杀案」（第 1 个义项：一人被他人杀害的行为或案件）；句意：发现尸体后，探员启动了一起凶杀案调查。图中可辨识物件：警戒线、雨伞、相机与尸体角标。

pos.zh: 杀人者（美式英语，常见于法律与警方用语）

collocations.zh: 正当杀人（依法不构成犯罪）

derivatives.zh: 由 homicide 加后缀 -al 构成，义为「有杀人倾向的；与杀人有关的」
由 homicidal 再加 -ly 构成，义为「以杀人的方式」，较少使用
由拉丁语 homicida 直接借来的旧式同义词，义同「杀人者」，现代英语罕见
与 homicide 共用 -cide 词尾的同族词，义为「杀害兄弟姊妹」

senses.title: The killing of one person by another
senses.definition: the act of killing another person, especially when it is treated by law as a crime
senses.definitionCN: 杀害另一个人的行为，尤指被法律视为犯罪的行为
senses.example: The court charged him with homicide.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭指控他犯有杀人罪。
senses.why: Latin homo means a human being and -cide means a killing, so homicide is literally the killing of a human; the core image of one hand cutting off another life is built into the word itself.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 homo 意为「人」，-cide 意为「杀」，所以 homicide 字面就是「杀一个人」；一只手切断另一条生命的核心意象，本来就写在构词里。

senses.title: The police and court case
senses.definition: a case, investigation or charge in which one person is accused of killing another
senses.definitionCN: 一人被指控杀害他人的案件、调查或指控
senses.example: The unit handles every homicide in the county.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小组负责本县所有的凶杀案件。
senses.why: Because the law must decide whether a killing was lawful, the single act becomes a file, an investigation and a trial, and the same noun comes to name the case itself.
senses.whyCN: 因为法律必须判定杀死是否合法，这一行为就被推进档案、调查与审判的流程，于是同一个词也用来指整个案件。

senses.title: The person who kills
senses.definition: a person who kills another person, used mainly in American legal and police English
senses.definitionCN: 杀害他人的人，主要用于美国法律与警方用语
senses.example: Police described the homicide as armed and dangerous.
senses.exampleCN: 警方称这名杀人者携带武器、十分危险。
senses.why: The Latin word homicida named the killer, and the borrowed form homilicide survives as a rare synonym; American usage let the noun shift from the deed to the doer.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 homicida 本来指杀人者，借入的旧式同义词 homilicide 仍保留这层意思；美式用法又让这个名词从「行为」转到「人」。

senses.title: Unlawful killing as a legal category
senses.definition: one of the legal categories for the killing of a person by another, covering murder and manslaughter
senses.definitionCN: 法律上把一人被杀分门别类的上位概念，涵盖谋杀与非预谋杀人
senses.example: Homicide includes both murder and manslaughter.
senses.exampleCN: 在法律上，他杀既包括谋杀也包括非预谋杀人。
senses.why: The act of killing a person is the plain fact; the law splits that fact into murder, manslaughter and lawful killing, and keeps homicide as the neutral name for the whole group.
senses.whyCN: 一人被杀是赤裸的事实，法律再把这一事实分成谋杀、非预谋杀人与合法杀人，而 homicide 仍是统称整组的中性名词。

senses.title: Justifiable or excusable killing
senses.definition: a killing that the law excuses or permits, such as self defence
senses.definitionCN: 法律认为可以免责或允许的杀人，如正当防卫
senses.example: The jury ruled that the shooting was a justifiable homicide.
senses.exampleCN: 陪审团裁定这次枪击属于依法无罪的杀人。
senses.why: If the criminal label is lifted, the murder is gone but the killing remains; the neutral word for killing therefore survives in legal phrases such as justifiable homicide.
senses.whyCN: 一旦摘掉犯罪标签，谋杀就不成立，但杀人的事实还在，所以表示「杀人」这个中性词就留在了「正当杀人」这类法律短语里。

intro.en: Homicide comes from Latin, built from homo, a human being, and -cida, a cutter or killer; the suffix itself goes back to caedere, to cut.
intro.cn: homicide 来自拉丁语，由 homo（人）与 -cida（砍、杀的人）构成，而后缀又追溯到 caedere（切割）。

items.en: Caedere meant to cut, hew or strike, and it also formed occidere and interficere, the everyday verbs for killing.
items.cn: caedere 意为「切、砍、击打」，它还参与构成 occidere 与 interficere，是拉丁语里表示「杀」的常用动词。

items.en: The combining element -cidium marked a cutting down, and the related agent noun -cida marked the one who cuts.
items.cn: 组合成分 -cidium 表示「砍倒、杀死」的行为，指人的 -cida 则表示「下杀手的人」。

items.en: Homicidium joined homo and -cidium to mean the killing of a human being; the agent noun homicida, a killer, was formed on the same pattern.
items.cn: homicidium 由 homo 与 -cidium 构成，意为「杀害人类」；同构的指人名词 homicida 意为「杀人者」。

items.en: Old French homicide borrowed the word and carried the sense of manslaughter and the killing of one person by another.
items.cn: 古法语 homicide 借入这个词，带有「杀人、一人杀另一人」的意思。

items.en: The noun is recorded in English from the fourteenth century, at first mostly in legal writing.
items.cn: 这一名词在十四世纪进入英语记录，最初多出现在法律文书中。

items.en: Modern legal English keeps homicide as the neutral umbrella term, while American police usage extended the noun to the killer as well.
items.cn: 现代法律英语把 homicide 保留为中性上位词，而美国警方用语又把名词扩展到「杀人者」。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers other compounds with the same killing suffix; the near-meaning group gathers the legal labels that a killing can carry.
note.cn: 形近组收同样带「杀」后缀的合成词；近义组收「杀人行为」在法律上可能得到的各种标签。

entries.definition: The killing of a brother or sister, or a person who does this; built with the same -cide suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「杀害兄弟姊妹；杀兄弟姊妹者」，用同一个 -cide 后缀构成。

entries.definition: The act of ending your own life, or a person who does so; the self replaces the other person.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「自杀；自杀者」，把「他人」换成了「自己」。

entries.definition: The deliberate killing of a whole people or ethnic group; the scale is far larger than in homicide.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「种族灭绝」，指对整个民族或族群的蓄意屠杀，规模远大于一般的凶杀。

entries.definition: The unlawful and intentional killing of a person; narrower and harsher than homicide because it already implies malice.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「谋杀」，指非法且蓄意的杀人，比 homicide 狭窄也更严厉，因为它已经含有恶意。

entries.definition: The unlawful killing of a person without malice aforethought; it is one kind of homicide.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「非预谋杀人」，指无预谋恶意的非法杀人，是 homicide 的一种。

entries.definition: The plain act of causing death; the everyday word that legal language replaces with homicide.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「杀害」，是日常说法，法律语体则用 homicide 这样的术语。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin pieces homo and -cide, and the phrases the word really appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁成分 homo 与 -cide，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Latin homo means a human being, so homicide is a human being plus a killing.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 homo 意为「人」，所以 homicide 就是「人」加上「杀」。

normal.en: The suffix -cide cuts, as in suicide, genocide and insecticide.
normal.cn: 后缀 -cide 表示「切、杀」，如 suicide、genocide 与 insecticide。

normal.en: A homicide detective turns up whenever a death is treated as a killing.
normal.cn: 每当一起死亡被当作他杀，就会出场 homicide detective（凶杀案探员）。

normal.en: Homicide is the umbrella; murder and manslaughter are the two common rooms under it.
normal.cn: homicide 是总称，谋杀与非预谋杀人是它下面的两个常见分类。

normal.en: Justifiable homicide means a killing the law does not punish.
normal.cn: justifiable homicide 指法律不予惩罚的杀人。

abstract.en: Picture a hand holding a knife, and the knife has a Latin label on it reading -cide.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手握着刀，刀上刻着拉丁标签 -cide。

abstract.en: Picture a case file folder; the killing itself is one line inside it, but the folder is what the court keeps.
abstract.cn: 想象一只案卷夹：杀人本身只是里面的一行字，法庭保存的却是整只夹子。

abstract.en: Picture the same knife handed to a witness box, where the label changes from killing to killer.
abstract.cn: 想象同一把刀被递到证人席，标签从「杀人」变成了「杀人者」。

examples.en: The report shows a fall in the homicide rate over ten years.
examples.cn: 报告显示过去十年凶杀案发生率有所下降。

examples.en: She works as a homicide detective in the city.
examples.cn: 她在本市担任凶杀案探员。

examples.en: The defence argued that the death was an accident, not a homicide.
examples.cn: 辩方主张那起死亡是意外，而非凶杀。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「好来杀」——好端端一条命，被人杀掉了，就是凶杀；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 homo「人」+ -cidium / -cida「砍、杀」（源于 caedere「切割」）→ homicidium「杀害人类」、homicida「杀人者」→ 古法语 homicide → 英语 homicide，核心义「一人夺走另一人的性命」。

sensesIntro.en: Homicide starts from the bare act of one person killing another, then names the case the law handles, the person who did it, and finally the legal categories that decide whether the killing is punished.
sensesIntro.cn: homicide 从「一人杀死另一人」这一行为出发，再指法律处理的案件、实施者本人，最后扩展到判定该行为是否受罚的法律分类。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand brings a blade down, and a life is cut off.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手落下刀刃，另一个人的生命被切断。

branches.en: THE ACT: a killing of a person is the plainest sense and the base of everything else.
branches.cn: 行为线：杀死一个人是最朴素的义项，也是其他义项的基础。

branches.en: THE FILE: once the police step in, the act becomes a case under investigation.
branches.cn: 案件线：警方一介入，行为就变成正在侦办的案件。

branches.en: THE PERSON: American usage shifts the same noun from the deed to the doer.
branches.cn: 人物线：美式用法把同一个名词从「行为」移到「行为者」。

branches.en: THE LAW: the neutral killing is sorted into punished and unpunished types inside the legal system.
branches.cn: 法律线：中性的「杀人」在法律体系内被分成受罚与免责两类。

branches.en: Justifiable homicide shows the legal end of the chain still pointing back to the plain act.
branches.cn: 正当杀人说明这条语义链的法律端仍然指回最朴素的那个行为。

intro.en: Homicide is a Latin compound of homo and the killing suffix -cide; English reuses that suffix in many compounds.
intro.cn: homicide 是由 homo 与表示「杀」的后缀 -cide 构成的拉丁合成词；英语把这个后缀用于许多合成词。

latinIntro.en: Latin caedere, -cidium and -cida are all recorded, so only reconstructed roots are marked as uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 caedere、-cidium 与 -cida 都有文献记录，本词族中没有需要标注不确定的重构成分。

items.example: Homo supplies the human element.
items.exampleCN: homo 提供「人」这一成分。

items.example: Caedere supplies the cutting image.
items.exampleCN: caedere 提供「切割」的意象。

items.example: The suffix -cida forms homicida.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -cida 构成 homicida。

items.example: The suffix -cidium forms homicidium.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -cidium 构成 homicidium。

items.meaning: the killing of a human being
items.example: Homicidium is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: homicidium 是直接来源。

items.example: The suffix -cide forms homicide and suicide.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -cide 构成 homicide 与 suicide。

items.example: The suffix -al forms homicidal.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -al 构成 homicidal。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms homicidally.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 homicidally。

definition_zh: 诚实；正直；坦率；真诚
definition_en: the quality of being honest, truthful and not deceiving others
core_image: 一扇敞开的窗，屋里的一切都落进阳光里，没有一处被藏起来
scene: 考试时有人把答案推到同桌眼前，同桌摇头没有去看。Her honesty about the mistake won her the respect of the teachers.
sceneCN: 这里 honesty 是「诚实」（第 1 个义项：如实对人、不说假话的品质）；句意：她对自己所犯错误的坦诚赢得了老师的尊重。图中可辨识物件：试卷、橡皮、推过来的纸条。

collocations.phrase: question the honesty of a witness

collocations.zh: 把诚实看得比聪明更重要

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词后缀 -y 后得到的基础形容词，义为「诚实的；正直的」
由 honest 加后缀 -ly 构成，义为「诚实地；说真的」
由前缀 dis- 加 honesty 构成的反义词，义为「不诚实」
由前缀 dis- 加 honest 构成，义为「不诚实的」

senses.title: The quality of being honest
senses.definition: the quality of speaking truthfully and of not cheating or deceiving other people
senses.definitionCN: 讲真话、不欺骗他人、不作弊的品质
senses.example: She is admired for her honesty.
senses.exampleCN: 她因诚实而受到人们的敬重。
senses.why: Latin honestas first meant honourable rank and good name; the core image of a life laid open to view turned that public honour into the personal virtue we call honesty.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 honestas 最初指尊贵的地位与好名声；「敞开的窗」这一核心意象，把外在的荣誉变成了个人品质上的诚实。

senses.title: Being straight with people
senses.definition: the habit of saying plainly what you think or did, even when it is uncomfortable
senses.definitionCN: 明白说出自己所想所做、即使令人不适的习惯
senses.example: Thank you for your honesty about the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 谢谢你坦率地说明了延误的情况。
senses.why: If nothing is hidden, the hidden thing must be brought out; honesty therefore also names the act of telling an uncomfortable truth openly.
senses.whyCN: 既然没有藏起来的东西，藏着的部分就必须拿出来；于是 honesty 也指公开说出令人难受的真相这件事。

senses.title: Sincerity in what you do
senses.definition: the quality of doing something willingly and truly, without pretending or artifice
senses.definitionCN: 真心实意地做某事、不加伪装或做作的品质
senses.example: There was honesty in the way he thanked them.
senses.exampleCN: 他向他们道谢的样子透着真诚。
senses.why: The same openness applies to feeling and effort, so a sincere apology or a plain gesture is an honest one even if no question of lying is involved.
senses.whyCN: 这种「敞开」同样适用于情感与用心，所以没有谎言可言时，一次诚恳的道歉、一个朴素的动作也仍被称作 honest。

senses.title: Honesty in speaking to yourself
senses.titleCN: 对自己的诚实；敢说实话
senses.definition: the willingness to admit facts to yourself and to others instead of softening them
senses.definitionCN: 愿意向自己和他人承认事实、不加粉饰的态度
senses.example: In all honesty, I never expected to win.
senses.exampleCN: 老实说，我从没想到自己会赢。
senses.why: The word is often used in phrases that open a confession, because the first person to deceive is usually yourself.
senses.whyCN: 这个词常出现在引出坦白的短语里，因为最先被欺骗的人往往正是自己。

senses.title: Honesty in a plant name
senses.definition: a flowering plant of the genus Lunaria, whose flat round seed pods look like coins or moons
senses.definitionCN: 缎花属的植物，其扁平圆形的种荚看起来像钱币或月亮
senses.example: Honesty grows well in dry shade.
senses.exampleCN: 缎花在干燥的阴处长得很好。
senses.why: The dried, translucent seed pods were once called moons or coins; some gardeners also say the plant grows more freely when no one fusses over it.
senses.whyCN: 它干枯后半透明的种荚曾被称为「月亮」或「钱币」；园艺里也有说法，说这花越是没人打理，反而长得越旺。

intro.en: Honesty goes back to Latin honor, honour, through the adjective honestus and the noun honestas; it is not related to the word one.
intro.cn: honesty 追溯到拉丁语 honor（荣誉），经形容词 honestus 与名词 honestas 而来；它与英语的 one 并没有词源关系。

items.en: Honor meant honour, office, personal worth and good name; the deeper origin of the word is source uncertain.
items.cn: honor 意为「荣誉、官职、个人声望与好名声」，这个词更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Honestus meant honourable, respectable and of good moral character, and could also describe fine or decent things.
items.cn: honestus 意为「光荣的、受人尊敬的、品行良好的」，也可以形容事物精美得体。

items.en: Honestas meant honourableness and later the moral purity and uprightness of character.
items.cn: honestas 意为「可敬的品质」，后来又指「品行的纯洁与正直」。

items.en: Old French honeste and honesté brought the adjective and the noun into English.
items.cn: 古法语 honeste 与 honesté 把形容词与名词一同带入英语。

items.en: The noun honesty appears in the fourteenth century with the sense of honour and honourable bearing.
items.cn: 名词 honesty 在十四世纪出现，带有「荣誉、体面的举止」之意。

items.en: Modern English narrowed honesty to truthfulness and sincerity, and the same noun was given to a plant with see-through seed pods.
items.cn: 现代英语把 honesty 收窄为「诚实、真诚」，同一名词又给了种荚透明的缎花。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the honest family whose forms often just add a suffix; the near-meaning group gathers neighbouring virtues that differ in whether they are about truth, principle or frankness.
note.cn: 形近组收 honest 这一词族，多由加后缀得来；近义组收相邻的品德词，区别在于它们指真实、原则还是直言。

entries.definition: Telling the truth and not cheating; remove the -y and you have the base adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「诚实的；正直的」，去掉词尾 -y 就是这个基础形容词。

entries.definition: In an honest way, or used to introduce a plain statement of your view.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「诚实地」，也用于引出自己直白的看法。

entries.definition: The quality of being dishonest; the prefix dis- reverses the word.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「不诚实」，前缀 dis- 把词义反转。

entries.definition: The habit of telling the truth, with no hint of money or cheating; narrower than honesty.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「诚实、说真话」，不含金钱与作弊的意味，比 honesty 更窄。

entries.definition: Strong moral principles, especially in public or professional life; more formal and more principled than honesty.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「正直、操守」，尤用于公共或职业生活，比 honesty 更正式、更强调原则。

entries.definition: The quality of saying frankly what you think, even if it is unwelcome.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「坦率」，指直说自己的想法、即使不受欢迎，与 honesty 的第二义项最接近。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root honor and the suffixes that build the honest family.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁词根 honor，以及构成 honest 词族的后缀。

normal.en: Honesty is honor plus the noun ending -y: what earns honour is kept.
normal.cn: honesty 就是 honor 加上名词词尾 -y：留住能赢得荣誉的东西。

normal.en: Take -y away and honest remains, the adjective that describes the person.
normal.cn: 去掉 -y 就剩下 honest，也就是形容那个人的形容词。

normal.en: Put dis- in front and dishonesty means the quality is gone.
normal.cn: 在前面加 dis-，dishonesty 就表示这种品质消失了。

normal.en: In all honesty is the phrase that opens a plain confession.
normal.cn: in all honesty 是引出一句坦白时常用的说法。

normal.en: Honour and honesty share a root, so both are about a good name.
normal.cn: honour 与 honesty 同根，都与「好名声」有关。

abstract.en: Picture an open window and a room where nothing is covered by a sheet.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇敞开的窗，屋里的东西没有一件用布盖着。

abstract.en: Picture a curtain pulled aside, so the thing you wanted to keep quiet is in plain light.
abstract.cn: 想象帘子被拉开，你本想隐瞒的那件事直接落在光里。

abstract.en: Picture a thank-you said without rehearsal, plain and true.
abstract.cn: 想象一句没有排练过的道谢，朴素而真实。

examples.en: In all honesty, the film was better than I expected.
examples.cn: 老实说，这部电影比我预想的要好。

examples.en: The company built its reputation on honesty with customers.
examples.cn: 这家公司靠对顾客的诚实建立了声誉。

examples.en: His honesty about the failure impressed the whole team.
examples.cn: 他坦然承认失败的态度让整个团队都很佩服。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「昂内斯提」——昂首挺胸，内里如实，说的正是诚实；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 honor「荣誉、好名声」→ honestus「可敬的、品行良好的」→ honestas「正直、品行的纯洁」→ 古法语 honesté → 英语 honesty，核心义「心里没有藏起来的东西」。

sensesIntro.en: Honesty begins as the public virtue of a good name, then names the plainness of telling and doing, and finally slips into ordinary phrases, sincere gestures and even a plant.
sensesIntro.cn: honesty 最初指好名声带来的公众美德，再指说话做事的坦白，最后进入日常惯用短语、真诚的举动，甚至成了植物的名字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open window with a room behind it, and nothing hidden under a cover.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇敞开的窗，窗后的房间里没有任何东西被遮盖。

branches.en: THE VIRTUE: the honourable character of Latin honestas settled into the everyday quality of honesty.
branches.cn: 品德线：拉丁语 honestas 的「可敬品格」，沉淀为日常所说的「诚实」。

branches.en: THE WORDS: if nothing is hidden, the hidden thing has to be told plainly.
branches.cn: 言语线：既然没有藏起来的东西，藏着的部分就必须明白说出。

branches.en: THE GESTURE: the same openness moves from words into feeling and action.
branches.cn: 举动线：同样的「敞开」从言语移到情感与行动上。

branches.en: THE FIRST PERSON: the phrase in all honesty opens a confession, often to oneself.
branches.cn: 自身线：in all honesty 引出坦白，往往是对自己的坦白。

branches.en: THE GARDEN: the see-through seed pods gave the word a second, non-virtue sense.
branches.cn: 园圃线：透明的种荚给这个词添了一个与品德无关的义项。

intro.en: Honesty is built on Latin honor with an adjective ending and a noun ending; English then adds -ly, dis- and related forms.
intro.cn: honesty 建立在拉丁词根 honor 之上，先后加上形容词词尾与名词词尾；英语再用 -ly、dis- 等扩展词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin honor, honestus and honestas are all recorded, and their deeper origin is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 honor、honestus 与 honestas 都有文献记录，它们更早的来源不确定。

items.exampleCN: honor 是这一词族的词根。
